message.content: Based on the discussion, Dyllan describes the combat in "Horizon Forbidden West" as challenging and diverse. He mentions that the combat can be tricky sometimes, particularly when dealing with flying machines. To handle these enemies effectively, Dyllan suggests using a bow equipped with elemental arrows to stun the flying machines before taking them down. Additionally, he recommends utilizing the "focus" system to track the movements of the flying machines, which helps in dodging their attacks. Dyllan also notes that setting up traps can be a useful strategy to turn the tide in battles. Overall, Dyllan emphasizes that the combat mechanics in "Horizon Forbidden West" require careful consideration and strategic thinking to succeed.
